papers.title: Decline in dementia patients during the COVID-19 pandemic: A cohort study in Taiwan.
papers.reason: The study monitors global cognitive decline in dementia using MMSE, CDR-SB, and CASI but does not specifically assess or model executive function.

papers.title: Rationale and study design for the Social Environment and Cognitive Health in Urban and Rural Areas Study.
papers.reason: This is a general cognitive-health cohort using MoCA and smartphone ecological assessments, without a specific executive-function construct or computational model.

papers.title: Gastrodia elata Blume and Acorus tatarinowii Schott mixtures alleviate pentylenetetrazol-induced seizures in mice: association with NLRP3 inflammasome signaling changes.
papers.reason: The paper concerns seizure treatment and inflammasome signaling in mice rather than executive function, cognitive modelling, or cognitive assessment.

papers.title: Epigenetic Aging Clocks Associate with Cognitive Status More Strongly Than Short-Term Cognitive Change: Evidence from the Parkinson's Progression Markers Initiative.
papers.reason: The study relates epigenetic biomarkers to cognitive status in Parkinson's disease but does not clearly target executive processes or digital cognitive assessment.

papers.title: Reactive agility and motor-cognitive assessments for distinguishing community-dwelling older adults with and without a history of falls: a dual-centre cross-sectional study.
papers.reason: The study uses task-switching, 2-back, Stroop, and reaction tasks in older adults, but its principal outcome is fall-history discrimination and the strongest findings concern agility and simple reaction time.

papers.title: Efficacy and Safety of Jiannao Tongluo Granules in the Treatment of Convalescent Cerebral Infarction: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled, Parallel-Group Clinical Trial.
papers.reason: The title describes a treatment trial for cerebral-infarction recovery without indicating executive-function outcomes, cognitive modelling, or relevant biomarker methodology.

papers.title: NMDA receptor ablation in medial prefrontal cortex disrupts value updating and reward history integration.
papers.reason: This study combines prefrontal manipulations, a restless-bandit task, and reinforcement-learning models to identify mechanisms of value updating, feedback use, and reward-history integration relevant to cognitive control.

papers.title: Prioritization in working memory reduces interference via beta band-linked stimulus transformations.
papers.reason: Human behavioural and EEG experiments directly characterize a low-beta oscillatory mechanism that prioritizes working-memory contents and protects them from interference.

papers.title: Association between Kidney Tubular Secretory Clearance with Cognitive Function among Adults with CKD in the Systolic Blood Pressure Intervention Trial.
papers.reason: The paper examines a medical correlate of general cognitive function in chronic kidney disease without a clear focus on executive-function mechanisms or digital assessment.
